title: A disc cam shaped by its motion law
pickerTitle: Disc cam from its motion law
line: A disc cam whose base circle and profile come from MATLAB functions for its cycloidal motion law.
description: A dwell-rise-dwell-return disc cam modeled as a .part file. Its dimensions come from MATLAB code in the same folder: camBaseRadius.m sizes the base circle to keep the pressure angle under its limit, and camRadius.m gives the pitch radius around the cam from a cycloidal motion law. Change the lift, the rise angle or the pressure-angle limit, and the profile regenerates from the functions.
thumbnailAlt: A disc cam with a cycloidal lobe, rendered by RunMat
